cards.possible_lore_text: “I like this place! It has atmosphere.”

zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 召集信众
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 1 个牧师并放入你的酒馆。每名对手各可选择一次，给你 1 个牧师以获得 5 VP。（将该牧师放入你的酒馆。）
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “善行总需要更多人手。”

cards.possible_lore_text:
“Death and taxes? The only thing
certain in Waterdeep is taxes!”
cards.card_text: Take 4 gold from the supply. Each opponent can choose to pay you 4 gold once to score 4 VP.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 征税
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 4 金币。每名对手各可选择一次，支付给你 4 金币以获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “死亡和税？深水城唯一确定的事，只有税！”

cards.possible_lore_text:
The Lords’ identities are secret to protect
themselves and their loved ones.
cards.card_text: Choose 1 opponent. Remove 2G from his or her Tavern and place it in your Tavern. Look at that opponent's Lord card.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 敲诈
zh_codex.card_text: 选择 1 名对手。从其酒馆移除 2 金币并放入你的酒馆。查看该对手的领主卡。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 领主们的身份保密，是为了保护他们自己和他们所爱之人。

cards.possible_lore_text: “Back so soon?”
cards.card_text: Choose an action space containing an Agent of an opponent with more Corruption than you. You use that space's action as though you assigned an Agent to it.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 变形怪！
zh_codex.card_text: 选择 1 个有代理人的行动格，且该代理人属于一名腐化比你多的对手。你使用该行动格的行动，视同你曾向那里指派代理人。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “这么快又回来了？”

cards.possible_lore_text: Closed doors can’t hold back justice.
cards.card_text: Each opponent with more Corruption than you takes 1 Corruption from the Corruption track and places it in his or her Tavern.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 揭露腐化
zh_codex.card_text: 每名腐化比你多的对手从腐化轨拿取 1 个腐化并放入其酒馆。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 紧闭的门挡不住正义。

cards.possible_lore_text: Delegating only works when you’re in charge.
cards.card_text: Take 1 Corruption from the Corruption track, place it in your Tavern, and give 1 of your uncompleted Mandatory Quests to an opponent with at least 1 Corruption.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 推卸责任
zh_codex.card_text: 从腐化轨拿取 1 个腐化并放入你的酒馆，然后将你 1 张未完成的强制任务卡交给一名拥有至少 1 个腐化的对手。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 只有当你说了算的时候，授权才管用。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The Poisoned Quill’s proprietor might be nearly blind,
but Issayk has the best hand in the business.
cards.card_text: Take 2 Corruption from the Corruption track, place it in your Tavern, and gain control of 1 Building under an opponent's control.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 伪造契据
zh_codex.card_text: 从腐化轨拿取 2 个腐化并放入你的酒馆，然后获得一名对手所控制的 1 个建筑的控制权。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 淬毒羽笔的老板几乎失明，但伊赛克的笔迹仍是行内翘楚。

cards.possible_lore_text: Dirty money is still money.
cards.card_text: Take 8 gold from the supply and 1 Corruption from the Corruption track, and place them in your Tavern. Each opponent can take 4 gold and 1 Corruption and place them in his or her supply.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 黑市资金
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 8 金币，并从腐化轨拿取 1 个腐化，将它们放入你的酒馆。每名对手可以拿取 4 金币和 1 个腐化，并放入其酒馆。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 脏钱也还是钱。

cards.possible_lore_text: Gold’s shine can be blinding.
cards.card_text: Spend 2 gold: Return up to 3 Corruption from your Tavern to the Corruption track. Each opponent can spend 4 gold to return 1 Corruption to the Corruption track.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 贿赂城卫
zh_codex.card_text: 花费 2 金币：将你酒馆中最多 3 个腐化归还腐化轨。每名对手可以花费 4 金币，将 1 个腐化归还腐化轨。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 金币的光芒有时足以令人目盲。

cards.possible_lore_text: No one who works in the gutter stays clean.
cards.card_text: Place 1 Corruption from the Corruption track on each of 2 different spaces.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 腐化影响
zh_codex.card_text: 从腐化轨拿取 2 个腐化，分别放到 2 个不同的行动格上，每个行动格放 1 个。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 在阴沟里干活的人，没有谁能保持干净。

cards.possible_lore_text: Life is priceless; death is negotiable.
cards.card_text: Take 4 Rogues from the supply and 1 Corruption from the Corruption track, and place them in your Tavern. Each opponent can take 2 Rogues and 1 Corruption and place them in his or her supply.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 黑匕首暗杀
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 4 个盗贼，并从腐化轨拿取 1 个腐化，将它们放入你的酒馆。每名对手可以拿取 2 个盗贼和 1 个腐化，并放入其酒馆。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 生命无价；死亡可以议价。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Cyric, the god of strife and murder, is
despised throughout the lands.
cards.card_text: Take 2 Clerics from the supply and 1 Corruption from the Corruption track, and place them in your Tavern. Each opponent can take 1 Cleric and 1 Corruption and place them in his or her supply.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 给希瑞克的献金
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 2 个牧师，并从腐化轨拿取 1 个腐化，将它们放入你的酒馆。每名对手可以拿取 1 个牧师和 1 个腐化，并放入其酒馆。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 希瑞克是纷争与谋杀之神，遭到各地厌恶。

cards.possible_lore_text: Taking the high road is sometimes worth the effort.
cards.card_text: Score 6 VP if each opponent has more Corruption than you.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 清廉表率
zh_codex.card_text: 如果每名对手的腐化都比你多，获得 6 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 走正道有时值得费些力气。

cards.possible_lore_text:
“Your purchases will be kept in Skull Island Prison
until you can retrieve them.”
cards.card_text: Take 4 Warriors from the supply and 1 Corruption from the Corruption track, and place them in your Tavern. Each opponent can take 2 Warriors and 1 Corruption and place them in his or her supply.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 铁环奴隶
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 4 个战士，并从腐化轨拿取 1 个腐化，将它们放入你的酒馆。每名对手可以拿取 2 个战士和 1 个腐化，并放入其酒馆。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “你购买的货物会暂存于骷髅岛监狱，直到你能取回它们。”

cards.possible_lore_text:
“I don’t want to know how you do it.
Just tell me when it’s done.”
cards.card_text: Take 2 Wizards from the supply and 1 Corruption from the Corruption track, and place them in your Tavern. Each opponent can take 1 Wizard and 1 Corruption and place them in his or her supply.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 夺心魔佣兵
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 2 个法师，并从腐化轨拿取 1 个腐化，将它们放入你的酒馆。每名对手可以拿取 1 个法师和 1 个腐化，并放入其酒馆。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “我不想知道你是怎么做到的。办完了告诉我就行。”

cards.possible_lore_text:
It’s the Lords’ job to make sure that crime
doesn’t pay–for anyone else.
cards.card_text: Take 1 Corruption from the Corruption track and remove them from the game.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 放出猎犬
zh_codex.card_text: 从腐化轨拿取 3 个腐化并将其移出游戏。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 领主们的职责，就是确保犯罪不会有利可图，至少不能让别人得利。

cards.possible_lore_text: Better to forgive small crimes than to allow atrocities.
cards.card_text: Return 1 Corruption from your Tavern to the Corruption track.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 忏悔
zh_codex.card_text: 将你酒馆中的 1 个腐化归还腐化轨。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 宽恕小罪，胜过纵容暴行。

cards.possible_lore_text:
“Someone’s gotta take the fall,
and it ain’t gonna be me!”
cards.card_text: Return 1 Adventurer to the supply and up to 2 Corruption from your Tavern to the Corruption track. Each opponent can return 2 Adventurers and 1 Corruption from his or her Tavern.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 替罪羊
zh_codex.card_text: 将 1 个冒险者归还供应区，并将你酒馆中最多 2 个腐化归还腐化轨。每名对手可以将其酒馆中的 2 个冒险者归还供应区，并将 1 个腐化归还腐化轨。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “总得有人背锅，但绝不会是我！”

cards.possible_lore_text: A coin in the right hand can pay off a hundredfold.
cards.card_text: Pay 5 Gold. Look at the top 5 cards in the Building stack. Put 1 of those Buildings into play under your control at no cost and put the rest on the bottom of the stack.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 快速扩张
zh_codex.card_text: 支付 5 金币。查看建筑堆顶的 5 张牌。选择其中 1 个建筑，不支付费用，将其放入场上并由你控制；将其余牌放到建筑堆底。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 把一枚金币交到合适的人手里，回报可能百倍而来。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The Lords of Waterdeep requisition
help in times of need.
cards.card_text:
Choose 1 opponent. Remove
 2 Fighters, 2 Rogues, or
 1 Fighter and 1 Rogue from
 his or her Tavern and place
 them in your Tavern.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 请求支援
zh_codex.card_text: 选择 1 名对手。从其酒馆移除 2 个战士、2 个盗贼，或 1 个战士和 1 个盗贼，并将它们放入你的酒馆。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 深水城领主在需要时会征用援手。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Sometimes tenants need a little
encouragement to move out.
cards.card_text:
Choose 1 Building in play
 that has no Agent assigned
 to it and discard it. If you
 were not the owner, pay the Gold
 cost of that Building to
 its owner. Put 1 Building
 in Builder's Hall in play
 under your control at no
 cost.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 拆除
zh_codex.card_text: 选择场上 1 个没有代理人指派其上的建筑并弃掉它。如果你不是该建筑的拥有者，向其拥有者支付该建筑的金币费用。选择建造者大厅中的 1 个建筑，不支付费用，将其放入场上并由你控制。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 有时租客需要一点鼓励，才肯搬走。

cards.possible_lore_text: Cue evil laugh.
cards.card_text:
Choose 1 opponent. Remove
 1 adventurer of any kind and
 2 gold from his or her Tavern
 and place them in your Tavern.
 Give this card to the
 chosen opponent after
 playing it.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 必然背叛
zh_codex.card_text: 选择 1 名对手。从其酒馆移除任意 1 个冒险者和 2 金币，并将它们放入你的酒馆。打出此卡后，将此卡交给所选对手。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 此处应响起邪恶的笑声。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The world is a machine of countless parts. One slight
adjustment can throw everything out of whack.
cards.card_text:
Choose an action space
 containing an opponent's Agent
 and move that Agent to an
 unoccupied space. The opponent
 can take the new space's
 action. Then assign 1 of
 your unassigned Agents.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 操纵
zh_codex.card_text: 选择 1 个有对手代理人的行动格，将该代理人移动到 1 个未占用的行动格。该对手可以执行新行动格的行动。然后指派你 1 个未指派的代理人。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 世界是一台由无数零件组成的机器。一点细微调整，就能让一切失衡。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Wherever you end up, high or low,
it pays to have friends.
cards.card_text:
Take 2 Gold from the
 supply and place it in your
 Tavern. Take the starting player
 marker.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 优待
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 2 金币并放入你的酒馆。拿取起始玩家标记。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 无论你最后身在高处还是低处，有朋友总是划算。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Two voices in prayer together accomplish
more than each alone.
cards.card_text:
Give 1 opponent a cleric
 from your Tavern and
 score 8 VP.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 信仰同盟
zh_codex.card_text: 将你酒馆中的 1 个牧师给 1 名对手，并获得 8 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 两道祈祷之声合在一起，成就胜过各自独行。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Sometimes the best innovation is controlling the Guild
of Stonecutters, Masons, Potters & Tile-makers.
cards.card_text:
Take 2 Gold from the supply
 and place it in your Tavern.
 You can purchase 1 face-up
 Building in Builder's Hall.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 建筑创新
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 2 金币并放入你的酒馆。你可以购买建造者大厅中 1 个面朝上的建筑。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 有时最好的创新，就是控制石匠、泥瓦匠、陶工及砖瓦匠公会。

cards.possible_lore_text: The potential return on investment is incalculable.
cards.card_text:
Give 1 opponent
 4 gold from your Tavern
 and score 8 VP.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 友好贷款
zh_codex.card_text: 将你酒馆中的 4 金币给 1 名对手，并获得 8 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 潜在的投资回报不可估量。

cards.possible_lore_text: No good deed goes unpunished.
cards.card_text:
Give 1 opponent
 2 Rogues from your Tavern
 and score 8 VP.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 盗亦有道
zh_codex.card_text: 将你酒馆中的 2 个盗贼给 1 名对手，并获得 8 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 好心从来不会没有代价。

cards.possible_lore_text: You just have to know where to look.
cards.card_text:
Draw 3 Intrigue cards.
 Each opponent draws 1 Intrigue
 card.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 情报掮客
zh_codex.card_text: 抽 3 张阴谋卡。每名对手抽 1 张阴谋卡。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 你只需要知道去哪里找。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Creating a new mercenary company can
bring prestige to the sponsor.
cards.card_text:
Give 1 opponent
 2 Fighters from your Tavern
 and score 8VP.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 佣兵契约
zh_codex.card_text: 将你酒馆中的 2 个战士给 1 名对手，并获得 8 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 创建一支新的佣兵团，能为赞助者带来声望。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Only one Lord is revealed to the public,
serving as the city’s chief diplomat.
cards.card_text:
Reveal your Lord card
 and discard any of your uncompleted
 Mandatory Quests. For the rest
 of the game, you cannot be
 affected by Attack and
 Mandatory Quest Intrigue
 cards played by opponents.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 公开领主
zh_codex.card_text: 展示你的领主卡，并弃掉你所有未完成的强制任务。在本局游戏余下时间里，你不会受到对手打出的攻击类阴谋卡和强制任务类阴谋卡影响。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 只有一位领主会向公众公开身份，担任这座城市的首席外交官。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Although the Eye controls most of Waterdeep’s criminal
activity, there are always a few independent agents.
cards.card_text:
Take 2 Rogues from the
 supply and place them in your
 Tavern. Place 1 Rogue from
 the supply on each of 2
 different action spaces.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 有组织犯罪
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 2 个盗贼并放入你的酒馆。从供应区拿取 2 个盗贼，分别放到 2 个不同的行动格上，每个行动格放 1 个。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 虽然眼主控制着深水城大部分犯罪活动，但总还有少数独立行动者。

cards.possible_lore_text: Dangerous times lead many to consider their souls.
cards.card_text:
Take 1 Cleric from the
 supply and place it in your
 Tavern. Place 1 Cleric from
 the supply on any action space.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 传教
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 1 个牧师并放入你的酒馆。从供应区拿取 1 个牧师，放到任意 1 个行动格上。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 危险的时代会让许多人开始思量自己的灵魂。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The City Guard’s frequent recruitment drives are
excellent sources of able-bodied adventurers.
cards.card_text:
Take 2 Fighters from the
 supply and place them in your
 Tavern. Place 1 Fighter from
 the supply on each of
 2 different action spaces.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 招募活动
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 2 个战士并放入你的酒馆。从供应区拿取 2 个战士，分别放到 2 个不同的行动格上，每个行动格放 1 个。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 城市守卫联盟频繁的招募活动，是健壮冒险者的绝佳来源。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The Watchful Order of Magists & Protectors shields
lesser wizards from those distrustful of the Art.
cards.card_text:
Take 1 Wizard from the
 supply and place it in your
 Tavern. Place 1 Wizard from
 the supply on any action space.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 赞助学徒
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 1 个法师并放入你的酒馆。从供应区拿取 1 个法师，放到任意 1 个行动格上。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 安民法师会庇护资浅法师，使他们免受不信任魔艺之人的伤害。

cards.possible_lore_text: “Do you think we asked for too much?”
cards.card_text:
Take 5 Gold from the
 supply and place it in
 your Tavern. Place 2 Gold
 from the supply on each
 of 2 different action spaces.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 抗税暴动
zh_codex.card_text: 从供应区拿取 5 金币并放入你的酒馆。从供应区拿取 4 金币，分别放到 2 个不同的行动格上，每个行动格放 2 金币。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “你觉得我们要得太多了吗？”

cards.possible_lore_text: Good fortune is always a nice surprise.
cards.card_text:
Draw 2 Intrigue cards.
 As you draw each card, you
 can play it immediately as
 part of this action.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 意外成功
zh_codex.card_text: 抽 2 张阴谋卡。每抽 1 张，你都可以立即将其作为本次行动的一部分打出。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 好运总是令人愉快的惊喜。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Woe to those who stand between an
alliance of two great powers.
cards.card_text:
Give 1 opponent
 1 Wizard from your Tavern
 and score 8VP.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex intrigue translation using locked project terminology, local DND references, and attempted wiki check, 2026-06-02
zh_codex.name: 意外援助
zh_codex.card_text: 将你酒馆中的 1 个法师给 1 名对手，并获得 8 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 谁若挡在两大强权的同盟之间，必将遭殃。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The widow of a crime boss who was also
a Lord of Waterdeep, Brianne has close ties
to the wizard Randulaith, a member
of the city's social elite.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each Arcana Quest and each Skullduggery Quest you completed.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 布蕾妮·拜恩德雷斯
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个奥术任务或阴谋任务，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 布蕾妮是一名犯罪头目的遗孀，而她的丈夫也曾是深水城领主；她与巫师兰杜拉斯关系密切，后者是城中社交精英的一员。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Seen by many as the layabout son of a noble
family, Caladorn has quietly taken control
of the ships that protect Waterdeep's coast.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each Skullduggery Quest and each Warfare Quest you completed.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 卡拉多恩·卡萨兰特
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个阴谋任务或战争任务，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 在许多人眼中，卡拉多恩只是贵族家庭里游手好闲的儿子；实际上，他已悄然掌控了守护深水城海岸的舰船。

cards.possible_lore_text:
A retired adventurer, Durnan owns the
Yawning Portal, a tavern that stands above
an entrance to Undermountain.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each Commerce Quest and each Warfare Quest you completed.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 杜尔南·流浪者
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个商业任务或战争任务，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 身为退休冒险者，杜尔南拥有哈欠门酒馆；这座酒馆坐落在地脉迷城的一处入口之上。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The master of Blackstaff Tower, the
accomplished wizard Khelben is famous
for founding and then abandoning
numerous organizations.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each Arcana Quest and each Warfare Quest you completed.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 凯尔本“黑杖”奥罗桑
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个奥术任务或战争任务，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 作为黑杖塔之主，技艺卓绝的法师凯尔本因创立并随后抛弃过众多组织而闻名。

cards.possible_lore_text:
A mischievous half-drow, Kyriani is a master
of manipulation who has come to terms with
her dual heritage of good and evil.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each Arcana Quest and each Piety Quest you completed.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 基里亚尼·阿格里瓦尔
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个奥术任务或虔诚任务，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 基里亚尼是一名爱恶作剧的半卓尔，也是操纵人心的大师；她已经接受了自己善与恶并存的双重血脉。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Known for her extravagant court parties
and her ability to blend in anywhere,
Larissa uses a courtesan facade to hide
her skill at information gathering.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 6 VP for each Building you control.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 拉丽莎·尼萨尔
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每控制 1 座建筑，获得 6 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 拉丽莎以奢华宫廷宴会和能融入任何场合的本领闻名；她以交际花的外表掩饰自己搜集情报的才能。

cards.possible_lore_text:
To outsiders, Mirt appears to be little more
than a drunk and a braggart. This disguise
hides his true cunning and wit.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each Commerce Quest and each Piety Quest you completed.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 放贷人米尔特
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个商业任务或虔诚任务，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 在外人眼中，米尔特不过是个醉汉兼吹牛大王；这层伪装掩盖了他真正的狡黠与机智。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The real Nindil was a good-natured halfling
and man of the people, who has since been
replaced by a doppelganger named Hlaavin.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each Piety Quest and each Skullduggery Quest you completed.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 宁迪尔·贾尔巴克
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个虔诚任务或阴谋任务，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 真正的宁迪尔是一名性情和善的半身人，深受平民爱戴；后来他被名叫哈文的变形怪取而代之。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Aggresive and fearless, the one-time
thief known as "Kitten" brings pragmatism
and a knowledge of the common citizen
to the Lords of Waterdeep.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each Commerce Quest and each Skullduggery Quest you completed.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 妮玛拉·谢伦
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个商业任务或阴谋任务，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 昔日以“小猫”之名为人所知的盗贼妮玛拉大胆无畏、行事果决；她为深水城领主带来了务实作风，以及对普通市民的了解。

cards.possible_lore_text:
A deliberate and honorable man, Piergeiron
often pretends to be slow of wit to lull his
enemies into underestimating him.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each Piety Quest and each Warfare Quest you completed.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 圣武士之子皮尔吉隆
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个虔诚任务或战争任务，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 皮尔吉隆为人审慎而正直；他常假装迟钝，以诱使敌人低估他。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Known as Sammer to his friends,
Sammereza is a master trade lord whose
sharp eyes never miss a detail.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each Arcana Quest and each Commerce Quest you completed.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 萨姆雷扎·萨尔方提斯
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个奥术任务或商业任务，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 朋友们称萨姆雷扎为“萨默”。他是一位贸易领主大师，锐利的双眼从不错过任何细节。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The city of Waterdeep is administered
by a secret council of powerful individuals
known as the Lords of Waterdeep.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 假面领主
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 深水城由一个强大人物组成的秘密议会治理，他们被称为深水城领主。

cards.possible_lore_text:
This mysterious Skullport archmage is
actually a disguise for Laeral Silverhand,
the Lady Mage of Waterdeep and
Chosen of Mystra.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, choose 1 Quest type. You score 6 VP for each Quest you completed of the chosen type.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 伊露西尔·埃兰斯
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，选择 1 种任务类型。你每完成 1 个该类型的任务，获得 6 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 这位神秘的骷髅港大法师，其实是莱拉·银手的伪装；她是深水城女法师，也是密斯特拉选民。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Sangalor, a priest of Oghma,
believes he has risen above the
base nature of his illithid heritage.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each non-Mandatory Skullport Quest you completed and each Skullport Building you control.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 桑加洛
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个非强制的骷髅港任务，以及每控制 1 座骷髅港建筑，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 欧格玛的牧师桑加洛相信自己已经超越了夺心魔血统中卑劣的本性。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Also known as the Eye, the Xanathar
controls most of the criminal activities
in Waterdeep and Skullport.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each Corruption in your Tavern.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 珊娜萨
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你酒馆中每有 1 个腐化，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 珊娜萨又被称为“眼主”，掌控着深水城和骷髅港的大部分犯罪活动。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Most see Danilo as just a dandy with
a charming smile, but behind this
demeanor is a clever and capable bard.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 3 VP for each non-Mandatory Quest you completed.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 丹尼洛·坦恩
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个非强制任务，获得 3 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 多数人只把丹尼洛看作带着迷人微笑的纨绔子弟；但在这副姿态背后，是一位聪明而能干的吟游诗人。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The Mad Mage of Undermountain
transformed the Underhalls
into a playground for himself
and a death trap to others.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 4 VP for each non-Mandatory Undermountain Quest you completed and each Undermountain Building you control.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 海拉斯特·黑袍
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个非强制的地脉迷城任务，以及每控制 1 座地脉迷城建筑，获得 4 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 地脉迷城的疯法师将地下厅堂改造成了自己的游乐场，也变成了他人的死亡陷阱。

cards.possible_lore_text:
An apprentice of Halastar, Trobriand
creates animated metal monstrosities
deep in Undermountain.
cards.card_text: At the end of the game, you score 5 VP for each Quest you completed worth at least 10VP.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex translation using locked project terminology, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 卓布伦德
zh_codex.card_text: 游戏结束时，你每完成 1 个价值至少 10 VP 的任务，获得 5 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 作为海拉斯特的一名学徒，卓布伦德在地脉迷城深处创造出活化金属怪物。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Not a glamorous endeavor,
but necessary.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 抵御强盗
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 这算不上光彩的差事，却很有必要。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The Zhentarim’s schemes of
world domination have spilled
into Waterdeep. They must be
stopped at all costs.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 阻挠散塔林会
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 散塔林会征服世界的阴谋已经蔓延到深水城。必须不惜代价阻止他们。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Shrewd economic policies,
backed up by appropriate
authority, address the trade
guilds’ grievances.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 安抚愤怒商人
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 精明的经济政策，再加上适当的权威背书，足以平息贸易行会的不满。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The peasants in the North
Ward are revolting!

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 平息骚乱
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 北区的平民正在闹事！

cards.possible_lore_text:
Small bands of dark elves
continue to emerge from the
Underdark to harass the city.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 击退卓尔入侵者
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 一小股一小股黑暗精灵不断从幽暗地域现身，骚扰这座城市。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The Cult of the Dragon has
set up shop in the North
Ward. Find the cultists
and deal with them.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 铲除邪教徒
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 龙巫教已经在北区落脚。找出这些邪教徒，处理掉他们。

cards.possible_lore_text: The Red Wizards of Thay use spies to gather information and sow discord throughout Waterdeep.
cards.card_text: Take 1 Intrigue card.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 揭露红袍巫师间谍
zh_codex.card_text: 抽 1 张阴谋卡。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 塞尔的红袍巫师利用间谍在深水城各处搜集情报、散播纷争。

cards.possible_lore_text:
“Waterdeep’s festivals for Sune attract
the greatest bards in Faerûn. You
are sure to learn from them.”

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 为淑妮举办庆典
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “深水城为淑妮举办的庆典会吸引费伦最杰出的吟游诗人。你一定能从他们身上学到东西。”

cards.possible_lore_text:
“Get in there and find out what
Halaster Blackcloak, the mad
wizard of Undermountain, is up to.”

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 渗透海拉斯特的圈子
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “潜进去，查明地脉迷城的疯法师海拉斯特·黑袍到底在谋划什么。”

cards.possible_lore_text:
Rumors of beholders and foulspawn in
the sewers have the citizenry on edge.
cards.card_text: Take 1 Intrigue card.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 调查异怪侵扰
zh_codex.card_text: 抽 1 张阴谋卡。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 下水道里有眼魔和邪秽怪物出没的传闻，让市民们惴惴不安。

cards.possible_lore_text:
“Step on up—you could be the next
Khelben Arunsun.”

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 为黑杖学院招募学员
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “快来吧，你或许就是下一位凯尔本·奥罗桑。”

cards.possible_lore_text: Time magic has unlimited potential.
cards.card_text: and return one of your assigned Agents to your pool.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 研究时序魔法
zh_codex.card_text: 并将你已指派的 1 名代理人返回你的代理人池。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 时间魔法有着无穷潜力。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Adventurers are needed to recover
treasures from the ancient
elven realm of Miyeritar.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 寻回远古神器
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 需要冒险者从古老精灵王国米叶瑞塔取回宝藏。

cards.possible_lore_text:

zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “保护泰摩拉的神殿，援助自然会来到你身边。”

cards.lua_key: Produce a Miracle for the Masses
cards.card_name: Produce a Miracle for the Masses
cards.possible_lore_text: “Another cleric called to the cause.”
cards.card_text: Once per round, whenever you take an action that provides any Clerics, you can also replace 1 Fighter, Rogue, or Wizard in your Tavern with 1 Cleric.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 为民众显现神迹
zh_codex.card_text: 每轮一次，每当你执行提供任意牧师的行动时，你还可以将你酒馆中的 1 个战士、盗贼或法师替换为 1 个牧师。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “又有一位牧师响应了这项事业。”

cards.possible_lore_text:
Defending Mystra’s temple
demonstrates devotion.
cards.card_text: Whenever you complete a Piety Quest, you score 2 VP.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 守护奇迹殿
zh_codex.card_text: 每当你完成 1 个虔诚任务，获得 2 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 守护密斯特拉的神殿，正是虔诚的证明。

cards.lua_key: Fence Goods for Duke of Darkness
cards.card_name: Fence Goods for Duke of Darkness
cards.possible_lore_text:
In some wards, stolen goods
turn a nice profit.
cards.card_text: Whenever you take an action that provides any Rogues, also take 2 Gold from the supply.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 为黑暗公爵销赃
zh_codex.card_text: 每当你执行提供任意盗贼的行动时，额外从供应区拿取 2 金币。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 在某些城区，赃物能卖出不错的利润。

cards.lua_key: Install a Spy in Castle Waterdeep
cards.card_name: Install a Spy in Castle Waterdeep
cards.possible_lore_text: “Watch and listen, watch and listen...”
cards.card_text: Whenever you complete a Skullduggery Quest, you score 2 VP.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 在深水城城堡安插间谍
zh_codex.card_text: 每当你完成 1 个阴谋任务，获得 2 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “看着，听着；看着，听着……”

cards.possible_lore_text:
“Pray your agent is good, for
Skullport is unforgiving.”
cards.card_text: Whenever you play an Intrigue card, you score 2 VP.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 在骷髅港安插潜伏代理人
zh_codex.card_text: 每当你打出 1 张阴谋卡，获得 2 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “祈祷你的代理人足够能干吧，因为骷髅港可不会宽恕失败。”

cards.possible_lore_text:
Elite griffon-riders patrol
Waterdeep’s skies.
cards.card_text: Whenever you take an action that provides any Fighters, also take 1 Fighter from the supply and place it in your Tavern.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 壮大狮鹫骑兵
zh_codex.card_text: 每当你执行提供任意战士的行动时，额外从供应区拿取 1 个战士并放入你的酒馆。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 精锐狮鹫骑手巡守着深水城的天空。

cards.possible_lore_text:
“No lord should resort to such
obvious machinations.”
cards.card_text: Whenever you complete a Warfare Quest, you score 2 VP.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 平息佣兵叛乱
zh_codex.card_text: 每当你完成 1 个战争任务，获得 2 VP。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “没有哪位领主该诉诸如此显眼的操弄手段。”

cards.possible_lore_text: “Good help can be so hard to find.”
cards.card_text: Add the Lieutenant to your pool of Agents for the rest of the game.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 招募副官
zh_codex.card_text: 在本局剩余时间里，将副官加入你的代理人池。
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “称心的帮手可真难找。”

cards.possible_lore_text:
A fighter is as useful as
a worm on a hook.
cards.card_text: F W 2G

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 清除锈蚀怪巢穴
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 对付锈蚀怪时，战士跟钩上的虫饵一样有用。

cards.possible_lore_text:
“My people have done a
thorough investigation and
found no indication
of wrongdoing.”
cards.card_text: C F R W

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 掩盖丑闻
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “我的人已经做过彻底调查，没有发现任何不当行为的迹象。”

cards.possible_lore_text:
The sewers make excellent lairs
for the foul undead.
cards.card_text: C R 2G

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 猎杀藏匿食尸鬼
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 下水道是这类污秽不死生物绝佳的巢穴。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The Cult of the Dragon
believes
 dracoliches will
one day rule the world.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 建立邪教据点
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 龙巫教相信，龙巫妖终有一日会统治世界。

cards.possible_lore_text:
What caused the Red Wizards to
abandon such a powerful ship?

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 调查塞尔船只
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 是什么让红袍巫师弃下了如此强大的船只？

cards.possible_lore_text: Better safe than sorry.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 重施卫护与结界
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 小心总比后悔好。

cards.possible_lore_text: Some things should stay hidden.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 封闭一处通往骷髅港的入口
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 有些东西就该继续隐藏。

cards.possible_lore_text:
When you open a school,
you close a prison.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 向城市捐献
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 你每开办一所学校，就少了一座监狱。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Fool’s gold is fine, as long
as you’re not the fool.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 资助炼金研究
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 愚人金也不错，只要你不是那个愚人。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Clerics of the goddess of wealth rarely
pay for anything themselves.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 资助渥金朝圣
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 财富女神的牧师很少自己掏钱。

cards.possible_lore_text:
“Whoever said crime doesn’t pay
didn’t
 work for the Masked Lords.”

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 缴纳罚金
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “说犯罪不赚钱的人，肯定没替假面领主做过事。”

cards.possible_lore_text:
“Wicked shadows and souls of
darkness, I abjure you!”

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 放逐邪灵
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “邪恶阴影与黑暗灵魂，我驱逐你们！”

cards.lua_key: Enter the Tower of Seven Woes
cards.card_name: Enter the Tower of Seven Woes
cards.possible_lore_text:
Acolytes at Loviatar’s temple must
progress through each level before
being accepted as priests.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 进入七祸之塔
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 劳薇艾塔神殿的侍僧必须逐层通过考验，才能被接纳为祭司。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The priests of Torm steer all
toward the righteous path.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 推行改革
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 托姆的祭司引导所有人走上正义之路。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Donating new items of lore is
the highest
 sacrament for
Oghma’s faithful.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 圣化欧格玛神殿
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 为欧格玛的信徒捐赠新的学识资料，是最高的圣礼。

cards.possible_lore_text:
“This is not what I meant when I said
I could work the graveyard shift.”

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 埋尸灭迹
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “我说我能上夜班，可不是这个意思。”

cards.lua_key: Rescue a Victim from the Skulls
cards.card_name: Rescue a Victim from the Skulls
cards.possible_lore_text:
Skullport has few laws, but if you
break
 them, the Skulls come for you.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 从诸骷髅手中救出受害者
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 骷髅港的法律寥寥无几，但如果你破坏了它们，诸骷髅就会来找你。

cards.possible_lore_text:
“If they don’t accept the ransom,
make them pay in blood.”

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 拯救被绑架贵族
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “如果他们不接受赎金，就让他们用鲜血偿付。”

cards.possible_lore_text:
“Sign the deed, and your
troubles will be over.”

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 欺诈建造者公会
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “签下契约，你的麻烦就结束了。”

cards.possible_lore_text: Dead people cause fewer problems.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 暗杀竞争对手
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 死人造成的问题比较少。

cards.possible_lore_text: Every dungeon can be dug deeper.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 加强监狱安保
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 每座地牢都还能挖得更深。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The oldest ward in Waterdeep
is notorious for drunks,
smugglers, and worse.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 巡逻码头区
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 深水城最古老的城区，以醉汉、走私者和更糟的东西而臭名昭著。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The streets of Skullport are lined
with Lolth’s secrets.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 揭露卓尔阴谋
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 骷髅港的街道两旁满是罗丝的秘密。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Some apprentices seek too much power
to be trusted by the Archmage.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 招募学院落选者
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 有些学徒追求过多力量，不值得大法师信任。

cards.possible_lore_text: Power corrupts.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 揭开禁忌学识
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 力量会腐化人心。

cards.possible_lore_text:
“What? We got rid of that carrion
crawler
 infestation months ago!”

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 抹黑竞争商号
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “什么？那场腐尸爬虫侵扰我们几个月前就处理掉了！”

cards.possible_lore_text:
The most dangerous thieves also
have a head for business.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 勒索奥萝拉
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 最危险的盗贼也有经商头脑。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Honesty is for fools, but apparent
honesty is valuable.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 向马斯克献礼
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 诚实是愚人的美德，但看起来诚实却很有价值。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The Dark Lady smiles on those who
see the deeper beauty within.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 保护伊莉丝翠皈依者
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 幽暗少女会向那些看见更深层之美的人微笑。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Agents of the Eye infiltrate
Waterdeep’s
 criminal underworld.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 扩大公会活动
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 眼主的代理人渗透进深水城的犯罪地下世界。

cards.possible_lore_text: The Black Network has a long reach.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 庇护散塔林会特工
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 黑暗网络的触手伸得很长。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The winners owe their fame to a
shipment of inferior weapons.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 操纵冠军赛
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 胜者的名声，来自一批劣质武器。

cards.possible_lore_text: A vigilant watch means less bloodshed.

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 训练城堡卫兵
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 警惕的守卫意味着更少的流血。

cards.possible_lore_text:
Before reestablishing their
presence in the city, the Shadow
Thieves must deal with the
Lords of Waterdeep.
cards.card_text: 2R W

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 躲避刺客
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 暗影盗贼若要在城中重建势力，必须先应付深水城领主。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The discovery of a sailor’s
brainless corpse in the Dock
Ward sets off a frantic hunt.
cards.card_text: C 2F

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 制服夺心魔威胁
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 码头区发现一具水手的无脑尸体，随即引发了一场疯狂搜捕。

cards.possible_lore_text:
A hidden succubus can tear
apart an entire noble house
from within.
cards.card_text: C W

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 揭露深渊密探
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 一只潜藏的魅魔，足以从内部撕裂整个贵族家族。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The Black Viper has her hand
in intrigues
 throughout
the city and beyond.
cards.card_text: 5G F 4R 2W

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 对付黑蝰蛇
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 黑蝰蛇在城内外的各种阴谋中都有她的手笔。

cards.possible_lore_text:
The “Metal Mage” turned part of
Undermountain into a junkyard
of experiments.
cards.card_text: 6G 2F 3R 4W

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 探索卓布伦德的墓场
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “金属法师”把地脉迷城的一部分变成了堆满实验品的废料场。

cards.possible_lore_text:
What secrets do the dead keep?
Why not ask them?
cards.card_text: 5G 3C

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 复活死去的法师
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 死者保守着什么秘密？何不亲口问问他们？

cards.possible_lore_text:
Those who survive encountering the Mad
Mage of Undermountain are usually
teleported deeper into the dungeons.
cards.card_text: C F 4?

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 在与海拉斯特会面中生还
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 那些遭遇地脉迷城疯法师后还能活下来的人，通常会被传送到地牢更深处。

cards.possible_lore_text:
“Disturb not the rest of those who served
Bereg Whitehelm, or the axes of the dwarves
will seek you out and fall upon you.”
cards.card_text: 10G 2C 3F 4R

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 洗劫白盔之墓
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “不要惊扰曾侍奉贝瑞格·白盔者的安眠，否则矮人的斧刃会寻上你，落在你身上。”

cards.possible_lore_text:
“Leave the exceptional
candidates for us.”
cards.card_text: C W

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 为城市哨卫招募
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: “把出类拔萃的候选人留给我们。”

cards.lua_key: Steal Gems from the Bone Throne
cards.card_name: Steal Gems from the Bone Throne
cards.possible_lore_text:
Attempts to plunder the Bone Throne
unleash its guardian magic.
cards.card_text: 4R 2W

zh_codex.label: 中文校译
zh_codex.source: Codex quest translation using locked project terminology and local DND references, 2026-05-27
zh_codex.name: 从白骨王座窃取宝石
zh_codex.possible_lore_text: 任何试图洗劫白骨王座的人，都会触发守护它的魔法。

cards.possible_lore_text:
